MINISTRY OF NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY (MNRE)
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
PM SURYA GHAR: MUFT BIJLI YOJANA OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES
Scheme Notification No. 32/2024-RE
Date: 13 February 2024

Clause 4.1 Central Financial Assistance (CFA) Slabs for Residential Rooftop Solar
Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, Central Financial Assistance (CFA) shall be provided for residential rooftop solar applications registered on the National Portal as follows:
(a) For residential solar system capacity up to 2 kW: Rs. 30,000 per kW.
(b) For residential solar system capacity beyond 2 kW and up to 3 kW: Rs. 60,000 plus Rs. 18,000 per kW for additional capacity beyond 2 kW.
(c) For residential solar system capacity exceeding 3 kW: Total CFA is capped at Rs. 78,000.
Eligibility is conditional on using ALMM List-I compliant modules manufactured in India with Domestic Content Requirement (DCR).
Effective from: 13 February 2024.
